rule: Preserve V25/V23 establish_distal_support. During raise_body recompute positive-bearing anchors and unsupported-foot placement from each fresh observation using the frozen R10AL search. Return only bounded joint targets, never a direct torso command.
fallback: When R10AL has no positive-bearing reference, no feasible candidate, no cost improvement, or undefined horizontal heading, retain the explicit reason and use the original validated V23 load-seeking reference from this same source observation. Do not reuse a previous contact mask or controller output.
selection_rationale: R10AL found admissible geometry on every exposed sample with positive bearing and its all-bearing ideal propagation reached the geometric posture goal. Its rear-only frozen-contact penetration makes actual fresh contact acquisition essential. This selects a development law, not a physical success or superiority claim.
input_validation: Reuse exact-S169 V25 mathematical descriptor, observation clock, joint/contact/COM and quaternion validation before searching. A future native composition must separately enforce source, ownership, energy, task phase and terminal refusal.
finite_work: 90 R10AL candidates, at most two IK branches per anchored leg or six line-search candidates per free leg; original V25/V23 validation/reference work is also retained and bounded.
